description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Homagama D/S Division, & other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration and intestate property claims under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple notices calling for claims to intestate properties, providing detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details. The content is primarily focused on land ownership and property transfer matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
